description: Run JavaScript in the page's own context and return its completion value. Use it for what the other tools do not cover — reading computed styles, walking a data structure the page holds, or checking a condition too specific for session_wait. Objects come back as formatted JSON, strings as themselves, and an expression with no value as "undefined". End the code with the expression you want back; a trailing statement returns nothing useful.

code.description: JavaScript to run in the page's own context. Its completion value is returned, so end with the expression you want back

tabId.description: Tab to run in; uses the active tab when omitted

name: session_evaluate
